details.coherence_justification: The candidate summary is internally coherent. Each sentence follows logically from the preceding ones: profitability metrics (S2–S4) are explained by the interest-rate environment and volume growth (S5), expense and income items (S6–S9) are presented in sequence without contradiction, and balance-sheet growth (S10–S14) is consistent with the narrative of business expansion. No self-contradictions, logical gaps, or unnecessary repetitions are present, and the overall organization flows from performance results to strategic actions and capital position.
